content_provenance: All assessment items, scoring algorithms, activity designs, and curriculum pathways are original NeuroScan AI constructs inspired by public cognitive theory (Structure of Intellect / SOI concepts) without containing proprietary or copyrighted test items.
compliance_rules: No diagnostic claims are generated by the Learning Ability system.
Scores are calculated deterministically without opaque AI hallucinations.
Reference cohort distributions are labelled as research reference distributions, not standardized national clinical norms.
All completed assessments retain immutable version timestamps and full response vectors.
